preamble: Deletion of the close front rounded vowel [y] is documented in colloquial French, restricted to the pronoun tu. In colloquial French the subject pronoun tu /ty/ loses its vowel before a vowel-initial verb, giving t'as /ta/ for tu as and t'es /tɛ/ for tu es, an elision that standard written French does not apply to tu.

examples.note: The /y/ of the clitic pronoun tu elides before a vowel-initial verb in informal speech.
Same elision of /y/ before the vowel of the verb form es.
